notes: All values come from MIT Office of Graduate Education (oge.mit.edu) program pages, which carry each program's deadline and English score requirements; the graduate-school ELP page (recommended 7 IELTS / 100 TOEFL) is not used because every program page states its own minimum. Sloan programmes (MFin, MBAn, MBA, MSMS) state they do not require or accept TOEFL/IELTS, so no ielts/toefl fields. Deadlines are recorded only where the page states the year and the date is not past; many departmental pages give the deadline without a year and are left out. Skipped: EECS (no terminal master's; MEng for MIT undergraduates only), MIT-WHOI SM (US Naval Officers only), IDSS and CSE (PhD only), and Music Technology SM (MIT undergraduates only). Several departments list an SM next to the PhD without saying whether SM-only applicants are admitted; they are included because the page lists the SM as an application degree. Programme-specific sites (e.g. mitsloan.mit.edu, department sites) were not read, so academic-background requirements are not captured.
